note: Q1: EQT, LinkedIn and Crunchbase all describe CCL as a third-party cold storage and logistics provider. Its customers are food producers, wholesalers and retailers, so it is not a brand running its own warehouses. Q2: ZoomInfo lists 201-500 employees and the enrichment says 461, both inside the 100-1000 band. PitchBook says 1,200 (group-wide), which is still within 25% of the 1000 boundary. Q3: web_fetch of the BBC URL was blocked (url_not_allowed), so I checked other sites. Place Midlands reports the same event: council approval of the £80m, ~109,000 sq ft Park Lane, Wolverhampton cold store. Its article is dated 3 June 2026, and Express & Star / Hits Radio reported planners recommending approval in late May 2026. The approval therefore happened around early June 2026, before the window starts on 2026-07-15. The BBC/LDRS piece dated 27 Aug 2026 is a later report of an event that falls outside the window, so the event date fails.
